name: face-model
version: v1 (ThaiSLM v9; shipped unchanged in v10)
task: signer facial emotion (7 classes) + valence / arousal + Thai explanation
input: MediaPipe Holistic face blendshapes (52) + 68 face points — same extractor as the sign pipeline (browser and server)
model: standardise → multinomial logistic regression (L2 0.01), temperature 1.60; 208 features
training_data: RAVDESS video speech, 24 actors × 60 clips (calm folded into neutral), clips + 2 s windows; Livingstone & Russo 2018, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 — research / non-commercial use; + 720 neutral samples of dictionary signing (TTRS / th_sl training-role signers, no emotion words)
evaluation: leave-actors-out (6 folds × 4 actors); sign videos of held-out signers: python main.py face-model signs
v10: face v2 candidates (more neutral signing, emotion-word signing, mouthing mask, a domain input) evaluated with signer-level cross-validation: none better than v1 on every metric (emotion accuracy, neutral-vs-emotion, false emotion on neutral signing, valence agreement) → v1 kept; artifacts/reports/face_model_v2.json, result_reporting/result_v10.md §5
